summary_en: 600,000 shares (2.0% of shares outstanding), ¥1.0B ceiling. Open-market purchase on TSE. Jun 30–Oct 31, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: NAGAILEBEN announced a share buyback authorization on 29 June 2026. The board resolved to acquire up to 600,000 ordinary shares (2.0% of shares outstanding, calculated as 600,000 ÷ 29,969,474 = 2.0%) for a maximum ¥1.0 billion using open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The execution window is 30 June 2026 through 31 October 2026. The company cites its charter authorization and states the purchase supports flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The company notes its longstanding commitment to shareholder returns and states this buyback is grounded in comprehensive consideration of financial and stock-price conditions to enhance shareholder value.
